name: What needs to be done before bathroom drywall can be installed?

mainEntity.name: What needs to be done before bathroom drywall can be installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before bathroom drywall installation begins, complete all plumbing, electrical rough-ins, custom framing adjustments, and insulation. Take reference photos or measurements of pipe and wire locations before the studs are covered, and verify that exhaust fan ducting vents properly outside. Deciding on your bathroom layout beforehand is critical—for example, marking the exact placement of heavy fixtures, grab bars, floating vanities, or wall-mounted mirrors allows the crew to install solid wood blocking between the studs before the drywall goes up. Once drywall and paint are installed, adding structural backing behind the wall requires cutting back into finished surfaces.
acceptedAnswer.description: All plumbing, electrical rough-ins, insulation, and solid wood backing for heavy fixtures like vanities or grab bars must be completed before hanging drywall.
